data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 月夜落地窗前的交颈缠绵
data.description: 巨大哥特式拱窗外是一轮硕大的圆月。真丝睡袍完全敞开滑落在脚踝处，雾枝双手环抱住对方的脖颈，双腿紧紧盘在腰间，眼底带着被彻底征服的迷离与无尽的依恋。

data.lighting: magnificent silver full moon backlighting their intertwined silhouette with ethereal silver glow
data.promptProse: Framed against a vast full moon outside a tall gothic window, Kirie clings to her partner with arms looped around his neck and legs wrapped tightly around his waist as they share a lingering kiss. Cool silver moonlight rims both figures against the dark chamber.
data.animaCaption: Held aloft before the tall gothic arched window under a giant full moon, she wraps her arms around her partner's neck and locks both bare legs around his waist in a deep kiss as her crimson silk peignoir falls open to her ankles.
data.nsfwProse: Her floor-length blood-red silk peignoir with black lace trim hangs completely open and slipped off her shoulders, leaving her breasts, back, and hips bare in the moonlight.
